messages.title: A Proud Moment, Honouring the Sculptors!
messages.description:
Heartfelt thanks to the Government of Maharashtra for announcing the Smriti Awards in the name of Late Master Dinanath Veling and Late Vijay Khatue to encourage sculptors.

On 19 August 2026, the announcement of an award in Late Sculptor Dinanath Veling’s name on his death anniversary is a proud moment for artists and art lovers.
